_notes: Declared as data; nothing reads this file yet. Every number is RC's CURRENT value, read 2026-10-31 from rc/main.js (lines 99-118, 168), rc/visuals.js (LIGHTING, followSun, GRADE) and rc/adaptive-resolution.mjs.

base 'f22-desktop' = the flight game's korea-1950s visual-profile.json, quality tier 'desktop' (render/visual/profile.js). Flight values for comparison: toneMapping aces_filmic, exposure 1.02, fog linear #A8C1CC 9000-56000 m, ambient 1.35, sun 2.4 #FFE3B7, shadow map 2048, shadow distance 6000 m.

Differs: exposure (RC 1.10-1.15, 0.82 under the HDRI polish path, vs flight 1.02). Believed: the toy palette is saturated and bright; the RC grade pass (saturation 1.14, contrast 1.07, vignette .24) was tuned by eye on top of it, and RC has a post-tone-map grade the flight game lacks.

Differs: fog (RC 65-150 m scene default, 180-950 m on tracks, 280-680 m open world vs flight 9000-56000 m). Believed: toy scale, a 1:10 car; 1 RC metre reads as ~10 real metres, so haze must start close to keep the horizon soft. Converge by scale factor, not by copying kilometres.

Differs: sun colour/intensity (RC outdoor #fff1db x3.4, open world #ffe4bf; flight #FFE3B7 x2.4) and hemisphere (RC 1.35 outdoor / 2.1 indoor vs flight ambient 1.35). Believed: kid-facing warm golden afternoon; indoor tracks (bx, school) need a bright even ceiling light.

Differs: shadow box (RC +-20 m on tracks, +-38 m open world, +-65 m default, contact sun +-6 m with its own 1024 map vs flight 2048 map over up to 3000 m). Believed: texel density, ~2 cm texels at toy scale keep tyre contact legible. Snap is world-axis in RC (visuals.js followSun) and light-space in flight (shadow_stabilizer.js); shared/sun.js has both.

Differs: adaptive resolution. RC is a percentile policy on frame time (p75, slow 19 ms, calm 17.8 ms, step .15 pixel ratio, window 90 frames) because WebKit's whole-millisecond frame clock produces pacing tails; flight is an EMA scale controller (target 60 fps, down 1.08x, up .82x). Not numerically comparable; the shared module hosts RC's policy.
Same already: ACES filmic tone mapping, sRGB output, PCFSoftShadowMap shadows.
